tool_input.prompt: Investigate why the cache returns stale data. Hypothesis: the LRUCache in app/cache.py is stale because TTL is 0 and db.connect() leaks connections. Report the root cause.

tool_response.prompt: Investigate why the cache returns stale data. Hypothesis: the LRUCache in app/cache.py is stale because TTL is 0 and db.connect() leaks connections. Report the root cause.

content.text:
Root cause: app/cache.py sets TTL=0, so LRUCache entries never expire.
The db.connect() leak hypothesis is wrong: every connection is closed in app/db.py.
